change: Runtime honors QAITU_MODEL_BUNDLE, explicit development-model permission and optional expected SHA-256. Invalid bundles fail instead of silently selecting another model.

real_video_probe.scope: one development video; runtime check, not accuracy evaluation

configuration.QAITU_MODEL_BUNDLE: absolute path to privately transferred baseline-audited-v4 bundle directory
configuration.QAITU_ALLOW_DEVELOPMENT_MODEL: true only for explicitly authorized development/demo evaluation

deployment: Code does not switch a running service; restart and verify the selected model before use.
quality: No retraining or accuracy gain is claimed. Whole-video Qwen adapter remains experimental and not promoted.
